title: János Bán
subtitle: Medior Full-Stack & Hybrid Mobile Engineer
about:
Hi, I'm János Bán, Medior Full-Stack & Hybrid Mobile Engineer. My core focus is Angular (17-21, standalone components, reactive Signals state management), type-safe TypeScript, and offline-first Ionic & Apache Cordova mobile architectures.

At Inclouded, I contributed to complex software projects: clinical IoT telemedicine hubs, high-performance web Canvas polygon annotators, and field diagnostic mobile systems.

projects.description: Clinical and IoT telemedicine hub with external medical device integration (Withings, Polar API), OTP authentication, and Europe-region Firebase Cloud Functions backend.
Industrial computer vision annotation system with real-time Canvas pan/zoom rendering, HLS video stream playback, and S3/B2 pre-signed URL storage pipelines.
Offline-first Ionic and Apache Cordova mobile application featuring custom hardware Camera Preview plugins, automated iOS build pipelines, and local caching.

experience.expDescription: Engineering and development of medical IoT telemedicine systems, industrial video and polygon annotation tools, and offline-first field diagnostic mobile applications.
expDescriptionArr: Architecting Angular 21 standalone components and reactive Signals state management
Building Europe-region optimized Firebase Cloud Functions and Firestore security rules
Developing offline-first Ionic & Apache Cordova mobile apps with custom Camera Preview hardware plugins
Integrating Withings and Polar API asynchronous telemetry data pipelines

experience.expDescription: Designing type-safe web and mobile architectures, Firebase backend pipelines, and UI performance optimization.
expDescriptionArr: Creating type-safe Firestore DTO domain models and repository patterns
Managing asynchronous stream flows and race-condition-free transactions
Ensuring WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards and optimized rendering performance
